NAFS Accountants Slough

Professional Accounting & Compliance Services

NAFS Accountants is a dedicated accountancy firm providing reliable, compliant, and cost-effective accounting services to businesses and individuals. We work closely with our clients to ensure accuracy, regulatory compliance, and complete peace of mind, allowing them to focus on sustainable growth.

Request a Free Consultation
UK Certified

Our Services

Comprehensive accounting and compliance services tailored to meet your business needs

Company Incorporation

Complete company formation services including registration with Companies House and initial compliance setup.

Statutory Company Accounts

Preparation and filing of annual accounts in compliance with UK accounting standards and regulations.

Payroll Management & PAYE

Full payroll services including RTI submissions, payslips, and year-end reporting for your employees.

VAT Registration & Returns

VAT registration assistance and quarterly return preparation to ensure timely and accurate submissions.

Self-Assessment Tax Returns

Personal tax return preparation and submission to HMRC, maximising allowances and minimising liability.

Sole Trader Accounts

Comprehensive bookkeeping and accounts preparation tailored specifically for sole traders.

Partnership Accounts

Complete accounting services for partnerships including profit allocation
